honest.reason: Every figure matches the brief, and it avoids promising that the nets prevent losses, though 'so our crops aren't all in one place' is a mild inference about why the second field was added.

works_the_facts.reason: It repeats the given numbers without working any of them out, for example that six half-weeks came to about three weeks of produce (roughly $74 of a $540 share), or that $31,000 is about $120 per member household.

right_comparison.reason: It compares last year's setup with this year's changes, but it never puts rejoining next to the reader's real alternative, and it doesn't note that 52 shares left means most members already came back.
